```plato

    // The axis after Tangent in the right-handed cycle (Tangent of Tangent):
    // X => Z, Y => X, Z => Y.
    Bitangent(self: Axis3D): Axis3D
        => match (self) {
            X => Axis3D.Z;
            Y => Axis3D.X;
            Z => Axis3D.Y;
        };
```
